assertions: The component with TestTag = 'r14.report.actions' is not displayed
The component with TestTag = 'r13.invalid.actions' is not displayed

root_cause: The explicit screen-derived height created a bounded long-form viewport, but both ModalBottomSheet instances still used the default partially expanded anchor. The title and scroll body were visible while the fixed action row at the bottom of the full sheet remained below the device viewport.

remediation.r14_report_sheet: Use rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded = true) so the bounded report form opens at its expanded anchor and the fixed actions enter the visible viewport.
remediation.r13_invalid_feedback_sheet: Skip the partially expanded anchor only for INVALID_FEEDBACK; preserve the default expansion behavior for the shorter SHARE sheet.
